head.name: @fzlt/core/css-clock
head.lead: A page's own CSS @keyframes, on the kernel clock. The look stays in the stylesheet; Fizlet owns the time. Each animation under root is paused and reads its time from one custom property that a timeline moves through the ledger: .led { animation: blink 1s steps(2) infinite paused; animation-delay: var(--fz-t, 0s); } .bug { animation: walk 6s linear infinite paused; animation-delay: calc(var(--fz-t, 0s) - 3s); } - One shared requestAnimationFrame with every other engine on the page; off screen or in a hidden tab it asks for no frames at all. - Settles: after loops plays of span seconds it rests where it started (every animation whose duration divides span is back on its first frame) and the engine sleeps. A pointer over the root, focus inside it or coming back into view plays it again. - Reduced motion: play() lands on the rest frame at once (the still poster). - Recall: destroy() (or aborting signal) gives the root's style back as it was.

sizesNote: Measured on this build: minified and gzipped with everything it imports, the way npm run size checks the budget in CI.
